Gro data visualization reference

Every colour, the type scale, and several worked examples.

Categorical colours: identity

Six slots, assigned in this order, never cycled. Amethyst is the primary. When a chart needs exactly one colour, choose it.

1. amethyst#7b36c1#aa6cf6the primary
2. tourmaline#00848f#0bb6c5deep teal
3. topaz#a37300#d89b07amber gold
4. rubellite#ae1387#e851b9magenta
5. sapphire#0462d3#5097fftrue blue
6. emerald#008455#23ba7ddeep green

Accessibility stats: Worst adjacent pair under simulated protanopia and deuteranopia is ΔE 14.1 light, 12.5 dark, against a target of 8. Every slot clears 3:1 against its surface. But no four-slot subset survives the all-pairs test in both modes.

Sequential colours: magnitude

One hue, pale to deep. Amethyst is the default. Tourmaline is a second sequential, for the rare view that needs two independent magnitude scales.

Amethyst

100200300400500600700

Tourmaline

100200300400500600700

Use the full range is for continuous magnitude, where the palest step means near zero and may recede into the surface. For discrete ordered marks, start at step 300 (amethyst) or 400 (tourmaline) in light mode or step 200 in dark. This ensures every mark is visible.

Diverging colours: polarity

Topaz against sapphire. A spectrum of warm against cool makes the ends read as opposites. A neutral grey midpoint reads as nothing happening.

more topazno changemore sapphire

Status colours: state

Not drawn from the jewel palette, and used very sparingly. Never for a series fill, only something like a dot, an arrow, a threshold rule, or a delta. Always pair with an icon or a word, so the colour is not the only signal.

success#128737#2dbe56
warning#be7c06#f5a41e
danger#ce1c20#f6584e
● Healthy ▲ Degraded ■ Failing

Accessibility stats: Success sits close to emerald (slot 6) and warning close to topaz (slot 3), measured ΔE 4.1 and 5.5 in light mode. Role separation helps keep them apart. Status is always a small mark with a label beside text. A series is a large fill in a plot.

Chrome and ink

The greys carry a trace of amethyst rather than being pure neutral. This helps the chrome sit under the jewel tones.

Typography

Inter is used for all text, including in hero figures. The type system has two weights: 400 for what the reader scans past, and 600 for what they stop on.

Hero figure48 / 1.0 · 600
$4.2M
Stat value30 / 1.1 · 600
12,847
Section heading20 / 1.3 · 600
Revenue by region
Chart title16 / 1.4 · 600
Monthly active accounts
Subtitle13 / 1.45 · 400
Rolling 8 months, all segments
Legend label12 / 1.3 · 500
Enterprise
Data label11 / 1.2 · 600
268
Axis tick11 / 1.2 · 400
1,000
Table cell12 / 1.5 · 400
0.048
Footnote11 / 1.45 · 400
Source: billing export, 2026-08-01

On numbers: Columns of numbers use tabular-nums. Large standalone numbers do not, because equal-width digits can make a hero figure look gappy. Add slashed-zero wherever a zero could be read as a letter.

Figures: when the form is a number

If the answer is one number, write the number. A one-bar bar chart provides nothing that a state tile could not. Sparklines and deltas may be used for time series trends. Meters may be used for percentages and targets.

Meters

Use a lighter step of the same ramp for the unfilled track. This helps the whole bar read as one scale.

Charts

Follows these mark specs: bars capped at 24px with a rounded data end, 2px lines, a 2px surface gap between touching fills, hairline gridlines, and labels placed sparingly.
